payload.title: UDP datagrams
payload.summary: Parse strict UDP framing, construct datagrams atomically, and compute the IPv4 pseudo-header checksum with portable C17 byte operations.

prerequisites: Fixed-width integers, size_t, arrays, and byte-oriented big-endian encoding in C17
One's-complement addition and IPv4 address concepts
outcomes: Decode a UDP header and distinguish malformed lengths from truncation
Expose a payload only through checked offset and length values
Build and validate an IPv4 UDP checksum, including the generated-zero mapping to 0xffff

payload.exercise: Complete the TODO sections in lessons/05_udp/exercise.c.
checks: Implement explicit big-endian reads and writes with strict complete-datagram framing
Include both IPv4 addresses, protocol 17, and UDP length in checksum generation
Initialize failure outputs and leave the destination untouched after preflight failures

allowed: Caller-provided datagram and IPv4 address spans
Offline deterministic parsing, construction, and checksum checks
Portable code without packed structures, overlays, or unaligned casts
excluded: Raw sockets, packet capture, external commands, or live network access
DNS behavior, fragmentation, NAT, or application retry policy
